speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; please tell me, what is your baby's gestational age and how many hours has this difficulty breathing been present?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Given the prematurity (33 weeks) and onset of distress within two hours of birth, I suspect surfactant deficiency. Please confirm if there is a family history of RDS or significant prenatal care issues, and REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas.
